description:
Search the pre-built Unity asset index by type, name, path, or GUID. Predicates separated by spaces are ANDed; | inside an unquoted predicate value provides alternatives. Quote values containing spaces and escape literal quotes/pipes with backslashes. Combine related alternatives when they share the same scope, e.g. t:prefab|script n:player|hero.

Predicates (names are case-insensitive): t:<type>, n=<exact>, n^<prefix>, n$<suffix>, n:<substring>, under:<pathPrefix>, guid:<32-hex>.
Types: scene, prefab, material, animation, animatorController, genericAsset, script, texture, audio, shader, model, otherYaml, metaOnly.

Output starts total:<N> showing:<start>-<end>, followed by tab-separated rows. Default fields contain only paths. Use unity_ref_search to follow relationships from a known asset.

q.description: Query string with space-separated predicates. Quote values that contain spaces. Example: 't:prefab under:Assets/UI n:"Point Light"'

range.description: Row range as '<start>-<end>' (1-indexed, max 200 rows). Examples: '1-20' (first 20), '21-40' (next 20), '0' (count only). Default: '1-20'.

fields.description: Fields per result line (tab-separated). Fewer fields = fewer tokens. Available: tp, n, p, guid. `tp` shows `ClassName(genericAsset)` for ScriptableObject assets when indexed script metadata is available.
